title: UTMB Mont-Blanc — UTMB race page (2026 edition)
claims: The 2026 UTMB stat block lists 174 km and 9,700 m of positive elevation gain.
The page introduction describes the race as approximately 170 km with about 10,000 m of positive elevation gain around Mont-Blanc through Italy, Switzerland and France.
The 2026 UTMB starts on Friday 28 August 2026 at 19:45 from Chamonix and finishes in Chamonix.
The maximum allowed race time is 45 hours 30 minutes.
The page provides an official GPX download for the 2026 course.
The current embedded timing table totals 173.6 km with +9,700 m and −9,699 m across 17 rows; the 32-point table that previously totalled 176.865 km is no longer shown.

The 32-point timing table previously captured by this site (176.865 km, 14 mid-course service points) is no longer displayed; the current embedded table has 17 rows with icon-only services and cut-off times, and the 32-point figures are treated as a historical basis only.
